label: Google Sheets: Read
description: Reads a Google Sheets tab's rows, signed in or (account left unconnected) from the share link of a sheet shared with 'anyone with the link'. One call reads one page: at most `maxRows` rows from `offset`, and no more than fit the 100 KB a wire carries; `nextOffset` is where the next page starts, and `hasMore` says whether there is one.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Leave unconnected to read a sheet shared by link.

inputs.name: spreadsheet
inputs.label: Spreadsheet
inputs.placeholder: Pick one, or paste its share link

inputs.name: tab
inputs.label: Tab
inputs.placeholder: Pick a tab, or paste a link with #gid=
inputs.description: The tab to use. Empty: the first tab, whatever its id.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.label: Skip rows
inputs.description: How many data rows (below the header) to skip before this page starts. To read the next page, wire the previous call's `nextOffset` here.

inputs.name: maxRows
inputs.label: Max rows
inputs.description: The most rows one page holds. A page also stops early when more rows would weigh more than the 100 KB a wire carries.

outputs.name: rows
outputs.description: This page's rows. With a header, {column: value} each; without, {c0, c1, ...}.

outputs.name: nextOffset
outputs.description: Where the next page starts: wire it into the next call's `offset`.

outputs.name: hasMore
outputs.description: True when the tab has rows past this page.
